stutterheim.tagline: Establishing a cohesive brand experience with Stutterheim.

paragraph.grayTitle: Boosting brand awareness with impactful visuals.
paragraph.text:
Stutterheim is a premium fashion brand known for its high-quality raincoats, blending Scandinavian minimalism with exceptional craftsmanship.

Our team collaborated with Stutterheim to enhance its brand presence through compelling ad creatives, refined web design, and stunning photography—ensuring a seamless online shopping experience while captivating audiences with visually striking campaigns.

lineText.title: A Crowded Market
lineText.text: Fashion e-commerce is highly competitive, making brand distinction vital. We crafted ad creatives and visuals that cut through the noise, leaving a lasting impression.

lineText.title: The Power of Aesthetics
lineText.text: From product photography to web design, every touchpoint was designed to reflect Stutterheim's premium identity, reinforcing trust and desirability among customers.

lundhags.tagline: Helping Lundhags drive sales with ad creatives and photography.

paragraph.text: MycoMine is pioneering bioremediation with cutting-edge fungal technology, and they needed a compelling brand and digital presence to match their innovation. We worked with MycoMine to refine their brand identity and design a website that effectively communicates their mission, impact, and scalability — in order to attract funding and position themselves as a leader in sustainable waste management.

lineText.title: A brand built for trust and innovation
lineText.text: To resonate with investors and industry stakeholders, we developed a visual identity that balances scientific credibility with an approachable, modern aesthetic.

lineText.title: A website designed to drive funding
lineText.text: We crafted a structured, compelling web experience that highlights MycoMine's technology, success stories, and measurable impact—ensuring clarity for investors and partners.
